description: The President's address that opens the game: the inaugural address in an inauguration year, otherwise the State of the Union. Moves in order: the salutation, the occasion, the state of the country with slots for the world's real numbers, the levels of government addressed (Congress, the governors and states, towns and communities, families), and the close. Every part is a whole sentence said in public-domain presidential documents (the Daily Compilation of Presidential Documents, 2009 to 2026) with record words as slots. A sentence that claims something about the country names the world fact it needs (requiresFacts); the engine says it only when that fact holds in the world's records. A real politician's campaign slogan never ships.

slots.goal: What the President asks for, from the administration's recorded agenda.
slots.issue: What the speech is about, from the administration's recorded agenda.
slots.occasion: What the country marks this year, from the calendar records.
slots.name: A person from the records, as the President would say it (a guest's full name; a governor's, the Chief Justice's or the Vice President's surname).
slots.place: A town, county or state the President visited, from the place records.
slots.did: What states did, from the state governments' records.
slots.unemployment_rate: The national unemployment rate from the world's economy records, as a number such as 4.1.
slots.inflation_rate: The national inflation rate over the past year, from the world's price records.
slots.growth_rate: The national economy's growth over the past year, from the world's economy records.
slots.jobs_added: Jobs added nationally over the past year, from the world's job records, as people say it ("800,000", "2 million").
slots.jobless: People out of work nationally, from the world's job records.
slots.population: The country's population, from the world's population records.
slots.national_debt: The national debt, from the federal ledger.
slots.deficit_cut: How much the federal deficit fell, from the federal ledger.

mining.rule: A shape is kept when at least 2 documents say it as a whole sentence and one of them is a public-domain record from 2015 or later, which is its source.
